INSERT INTO project_statuses (id, project_id, name, color, sort_order, hidden, kind)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4,
                       COALESCE($5, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) + 1
                                     FROM project_statuses WHERE project_id = $2)),
                       $6, $7)
